curriculumAlignmentSummary: Unit 1 covers machine level representation of data, number systems, binary arithmetic, overflow and underflow, complements, signed and unsigned representations, floating-point numbers, coding schemes (ASCII and Unicode), operating system tasks, types, and resource management, application management, process management, file systems, software hosting, and programming software. Model and annual papers evaluate concepts such as system software, operating system functions, number system conversions, and software hosting types (SaaS/Cloud/Hosting).
